name: Abstention
description: Refusal probes inspired by LongMemEval. The adapter is asked about facts that were never observed but share lexical territory with stored memories. A correct adapter should return nothing high-confidence rather than fabricate via lexical overlap.

scenarios.title: Asking about an unobserved team should not synthesize a member from neighboring facts

events.content: Adira leads the Platform infrastructure team this quarter.
Beto leads the Payments squad this quarter.
Cyra leads the Search relevance team this quarter.

probes.query: Who leads the Growth Marketing team this quarter?

scenarios.title: Asking about an unobserved incident should not adopt a similar one

events.content: Incident on 2026-04-12 traced Checkout 5xx errors to a Stripe webhook secret rotation that did not propagate to production env vars.
Incident on 2026-04-15 traced Notifications email delays to a SendGrid IP warm-up policy change.

probes.query: What caused the Twilio outage on 2026-04-20 that affected SMS delivery for the Onboarding flow?

scenarios.title: Asking about an unobserved policy should not graft a similar one

events.content: PII retention policy: customer email addresses are purged 30 days after account closure under the data minimization mandate.
Log retention policy: application logs older than 14 days are archived to cold storage and removed from live indexes after 90 days.

probes.query: What is our KYC document retention policy for verified business customers in the EU?
